about: Pass criteria fixed before the final runs. Candidate arm vs baseline arm 'original' (the full-row request, no post-check), one case set at a time. Intervals are 95% case-level bootstrap intervals.
frozen: 2026-11-03, before the test and held-out sets were run with the final code

prompt_tokens_ratio.rule: upper end of the interval for median prompt tokens (candidate / baseline) <= 0.60

id_noncompliance.rule: revised answers that use an unavailable or unknown ingredient id: upper end of the difference (candidate - baseline) <= +0.05

format_and_consistency.rule: format errors (all calls) and change-list inconsistencies (revised answers): upper end of each difference <= +0.03

refusal_errors.rule: false refusals and false acceptances against the rule-based expectation: upper end of each difference <= +0.05

answer_quality_judge.rule: second-model quality judgement; not evaluated in the runs reported here

safety_retained.rule: revised answers that keep the heat-treatment steps (when raw meat or egg remains): lower end of the difference >= -0.02

rejection_of_attempts.rule: revision attempts the post-check rejects: value <= 0.10

latency_cost_ratio.rule: median latency ratio and median cost ratio (candidate / baseline) <= 1.0
